claim.quote: We report results of experiments performed with the KEDR detector at the VEPP-4M $e^+e^-$ collider. They include final results for the mass and other parameters of the $J/\psi$, $\psi(2S)$ and $\psi(3770)$ and $J/\psi\to\gamma\eta_c$ branching fraction determination.

date.locator: arXiv abstract page, submission date (arXiv:1311.7530, 29 November 2013)

key_value_text.quote: After our experiments the masses of J/psi-meson and psi'-meson which are the base of the psi-family spectroscopy entered the top ten most precise measurements of masses of elementary particles.
key_value_text.value: KEDR J/ψ and ψ′ masses are among the ten most precisely measured elementary-particle masses (KEDR web site)

name: Parameters of charmonium states from KEDR
notes: The arXiv abstract gives no mass values; they are not recorded.

summary.plain: KEDR at the Budker Institute's VEPP-4M collider reported final results for the mass and other parameters of the J/psi, psi(2S) and psi(3770) charmonium states. KEDR says the J/psi and psi(2S) masses it measured are among the ten most precisely known masses of any elementary particle.
summary.technical: KEDR at VEPP-4M: final results for the mass and other parameters of J/ψ, ψ(2S) and ψ(3770) and the J/ψ → γη_c branching fraction; beam energy calibrated by resonant depolarisation. (KEDR's own page quotes M(J/ψ) and M(ψ′) as the most precise measurements, in the top ten for elementary-particle masses.)

title: Parameters of charmonium states from KEDR
why_it_matters: KEDR's home page says its J/psi and psi' masses entered the top ten most precise measurements of masses of elementary particles.
